verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at better-auth.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of the docs pages (e.g. /docs/introduction.md), which agents can read directly. The docs also include an AI-resources section describing a hosted remote MCP server that exposes documentation search, examples and setup help to Cursor, Codex, Claude Code and other MCP clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on reports of agents using llms.txt or the docs MCP server, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt content is beyond its header.
